The center also allocates weekends to holding workshops on building robots, conducting some scientific experiments, or exploring space science, etc. This place, carved entirely from salt, is located 135 meters underground and is considered one of the best tourist places in Krakow, where children can explore the sections of the mine and enjoy the underground lakes and legendary sculptures in it. For more excitement, they can dress up as miners and join mining tours to gain unique experiences and learn new knowledge about the formation of salt crystals around them. Energelandia amusement park should have a place on the tourism map in Poland for Arab travelers, because it is the largest amusement park in Poland, as it includes 6 entertainment areas suitable for adults and children alike, and there are more than 70 rides, including refreshing water games, especially in the summer months.  If your children are wildlife lovers, they will enjoy learning about strange animals and listening to amazing information about these animals, as the park includes more than 1,000 animals of more than two hundred different species. It is worth noting that the park is located in the Oliwa Forest, which provides animals with an environment close to their natural habitat, on an area of ​​1.23 million square metres, and this area is approximately equivalent to 123 football fields.  This adventure will be outdoors, as Kashubia Land is located in Gdańsk, northern Poland, at the mouth of the Vistula River, where there is a charming nature of rolling hills and green walking paths, in addition to clear lakes in which the family can practice canoeing and learn more about the culture of the local people. All water sports enthusiasts also head to the Masurian Lakes, known as the Land of a Thousand Lakes, where fishing, swimming and sailing can be practiced. Some adventurous tourists also explore these connected lakes and enjoy the quiet and secluded natural areas during their cruises. Tourism in Zakopati is famous for visiting the Tatra Mountains, especially for those who love mountain adventure and off-roading, or riding the cable car to enjoy panoramic views of the mountains. This area is considered an ideal destination in the summer for lovers of hiking trails, as well as in the winter, as it includes ski resorts equipped with schools specifically for children.
